name: ashlr-stack
description: Static catalog of 19 tools declared by reviewed Stack source 0.2.2, a subset of CLI commands; the catalog version label is not an installed or published package claim. The stdio server dispatches CLI arguments and returns stdout plus any nonempty stderr as text, with isError reflecting command completion, not provider/client acceptance. It is a control plane, not a sandbox or redaction layer. Public CLI and MCP packages recorded at 0.1.1 require Bun 1.2 or newer on PATH even when launched via npm/npx. Both stack and ashlr-stack-mcp commands are needed; STACK_BIN can override the CLI path. Adapt setup to your client and confirm the server working directory and actual advertised tools. Project-scoped tools accept an optional absolute cwd so a server started outside the project can target it; resources always read the server working directory. Resources are conditional on existing cwd files and return raw text. Provider configuration may contain literal $(phantom reveal NAME) strings; Stack supplies no general expansion step, so actual client/provider credential setup remains necessary.

tools.name: stack_init
tools.description: Scaffold .stack.toml in the current directory; a selected template may also run provider setup.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_import
tools.description: Import nonempty new variables from an .env file into Phantom and record detected services; existing vault names are left unchanged. Returns ashlr.stack.import/v1 JSON naming what was stored, skipped and wired (names only, never values).

from.description: Path to the .env file inside the project (default: .env).

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_scan
tools.description: Detect providers this repo uses by reading package.json / requirements.txt / config files.

path.description: Directory to scan inside the project (default: cwd).

confidence.description: Minimum confidence: low, medium, or high (default: medium).

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_add
tools.description: Run provider-specific service setup or attach an existing resource, then record returned secret slots and optional MCP configuration. Credentials and client/provider acceptance must be checked separately.

use.description: Existing resource id to attach to.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_remove
tools.description: Remove local service configuration and its MCP entry, and attempt Phantom secret cleanup. Returns JSON (ashlr.stack.remove/v1); `secrets_kept` lists names Phantom left stored, which headless runs always do, for the user to remove with `phantom remove` in a terminal. Upstream resources are kept.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_list
tools.description: List services configured in this stack.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_info
tools.description: Inspect configured resource, auth kind, secret-name inventory and MCP metadata; attempt a healthcheck when the provider supports one.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_status
tools.description: Show Phantom + services + config at a glance.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_env_show
tools.description: Show which declared secrets are present in the Phantom vault (masked).

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_env_diff
tools.description: Report which declared secrets are missing from the Phantom vault.

json.description: JSON: ashlr.stack.env-diff/v1; names and service only. Missing secrets remain an error.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_doctor
tools.description: Inspect the configured-service health report. --fix attempts supported remediation; stored vault names can cause repairs to be skipped, and name presence is not credential validity.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_sync
tools.description: Forward a deployment-platform sync request to phantom sync; inspect the installed Phantom command support and result separately.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_providers
tools.description: List the curated source provider catalog by category; inclusion does not attest complete provisioning or active credentials.

category.description: Only this category, any case (e.g. ai, database, payments).

tools.name: stack_projects_list
tools.description: List projects recorded in the local Stack registry; this is not a filesystem-wide discovery scan.

tools.name: stack_deps
tools.description: Show the service dependency graph for the current stack.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_templates_list
tools.description: List available starter stack templates and the services each one adds.

json.description: JSON: ashlr.stack.templates/v1; services, providers and secret names.

tools.name: stack_upgrade
tools.description: Check npm for a newer @ashlr/stack release. Returns ashlr.stack.upgrade/v1 JSON (current, latest, status, install command); installs nothing.

tools.name: stack_recommend
tools.description: Rank curated providers by query, returning JSON as text without LLM inference. save:true writes a Recipe for stack_apply.

query.description: Natural-language description of the project / stack need.

category.description: Category (case-insensitive): Database, Deploy, Cloud, AI, Analytics, Observability, Errors, Payments, Code, Tickets, Email, Auth, FeatureFlags. Unknown values error.

save.description: Save .stack/recipes/<id>.toml for stack_apply; returns recipe id.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

tools.name: stack_apply
tools.description: Apply a saved Recipe through provider setup, then report which declared secrets are in the Phantom vault and which are missing (names only; it never writes to the vault) and write webhook stubs. Inspect failures and skips. no_wire:true skips the vault check and stubs, not provider credential writes.

recipe_id.description: Recipe id (filename stem in .stack/recipes/, letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens).

no_wire.description: Skip the Phantom vault check and webhook stubs.

cwd.description: Existing absolute project directory; defaults to server cwd.

resources.name: .stack.toml (this project)
resources.description: Project configuration text when the file exists in server cwd; Git commit state is not verified and reads are not redacted.

resources.name: .stack.local.toml (local instance)
resources.description: Local instance data when the file exists in server cwd; inspect contents and project ignore rules before exposing raw text.

resources.name: .mcp.json (MCP wiring)
resources.description: MCP configuration text when the file exists in server cwd; client loading and usable credentials are not verified.
